title: 5 questions before you join a stokvel #Stokvel
text:
Before you pay anything: Can I see the constitution? Where is the money kept, and who has to sign before money comes out? Can I see last year's records? What happens if I need to leave early? When, exactly, do I get paid? If the answer is "don't worry, trust us", be careful. And if someone promises to double your money, or pays old members with new members' money, that's not a stokvel. That's a scheme.

Full guide: "Stokvels Explained: How to Protect Your Stokvel Money (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
